ogni punto è un pezzo di quello che l'ag: every dot is a piece of what the agent has in front of it: the task, the files it read, the results of commands and searches, its own replies. Pieces about the same things sit close together. The bigger the dot, the more tokens it takes. The bubble inflates as the context fills up (green, then yellow, then red); when Claude compacts it, the bubble deflates and the forgotten pieces drift outside as grey dust, while the summary stays inside.
